journey.title: Finish what the agent could not
journey.purpose: The defining journey. An agent gets as far as a wall it must not cross, and the operator completes only the irreducibly human step. Success is measured by how little the person has to reconstruct.

steps.intent: Learn within seconds that something is blocked, and which one is oldest.
steps.via: Arrive at the console after a notification or out of habit.

steps.intent: Scan the queue and pick the handoff that is actually blocking work.
Understand exactly which wall was hit and what only a human can do, with everything the agent already completed visible.
Confirm the step is done and hand control back to the waiting flow.
See that the originating flow resumed from its checkpoint rather than starting over.
